column12: surprise_desc:It depended on the amount of gems that caused me to stay. If below 65 I would proceed to next planet but this was after I was in the game for a few minutes.
column16: other_desc:It seemed to me leaving a planet after the first two or three encounters would give me more gems since I always got the most gems at the beginning at arriving at each new planet so this dawned on me after being in the game about 10 minutes or so. Because of this I did not stay on a planet very long.
column17: feedback:It was best to collect gems by not staying on a planet but maybe the first two rounds then going to the next planet to accumulate the most gems.}
